name: Should I hire a dedicated painting company or a full remodeling contractor for a foreclosure?

mainEntity.name: Should I hire a dedicated painting company or a full remodeling contractor for a foreclosure?

acceptedAnswer.text: Opting for a single general contractor like HH Remodeling eliminates the scheduling delays and finger-pointing common when hiring independent painters and separate drywallers. Foreclosures rarely need just paint; they usually require door repairs, molding replacement, subfloor or drywall patching, and tile work. When our crew handles your project, Abraham Becerra directly coordinates the surface repairs, finish carpentry, and paint phases under one contract. This integrated approach ensures repairs are sanded and prepped to painter-ready standards, reducing project downtime and keeping rehab budgets predictable.
acceptedAnswer.description: A full remodeling contractor is ideal because foreclosures usually need drywall repairs, trim replacement, and general carpentry alongside paint, saving time and coordination hassle.
